name: Smoked Paprika
siboNotes: Pure smoked paprika is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated. Check labels to ensure no garlic or onion powder has been added.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container away from light to preserve flavor
Toast briefly in dry pan to enhance smokiness before adding to dishes
Add at end of cooking to prevent bitterness from overcooking
A little goes a long way - start with 1/4 teaspoon and adjust to taste
